annotations.title: Download a file in pieces (any type)

description: Get any file from a bucket as base64, in pieces, when your own tools cannot open the download link: PDFs, images, zips and other binary files as well as text. Each call returns up to 512 KB starting at offset (default 0); keep calling with the returned next_offset until done is true, then join the pieces in order and decode them. Check total_bytes first: a file over about 5 MB needs many calls, so for big files use storage_file_link instead. To find the file first, use search_storage_files.

bucket.description: Bucket name (3-63 lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens).

region.description: Region code from storage_plans or storage_overview, e.g. fra (Frankfurt), usa (Virginia), sgp (Singapore).

service_id.description: Object Storage service id, as returned by the matching list tool.
